headline: Prime ESE swell and cross-off wind — this is the day of the week.
today: Everything lines up: prime angle, 1.5 to 2.6ft pushing 3ft, and the wind sits cross-off from morning through a light evening. Clean and fun all day, best on the incoming toward the 12:48p high. Shortboard or groveler — this is the one to build a day around, and it's the best call across all five spots right now.

daysToWatch.note: 1.7 to 2.4ft E at 8s with light cross-off wind. Clean and solid — worth the drive.
1.6 to 2.3ft E at 7s under near-glassy light wind. Another clean, fun one back to back with Monday.
Prime angle to 3.2ft but NE cross-on all day until a light evening. Dusk session could be the play if it holds.
